title: mole analyze --json <path> failure envelope (CONTRACT.md §4.6)
description: M1-T7. §4.6 requires the FAILURE payload, not the success payload, on a scan error: flat (§1.5 keeps analyze un-enveloped), error present, and no data key and no path/entries/total_size -- a failed scan has no entries to report and must not fake an empty list. Kept as a separate schema rather than a oneOf on analyze.schema.json because this validator does not implement oneOf (see validate.py's SUPPORTED keyword set) -- the brief's other option was not actually available.
